_README: Grouping behaviour, keyed by scientific name exactly as iNaturalist reports it. A photograph can show that a species schools; it cannot show that one lives in pairs, so anything other than 'schools' has to be curated here. This file OUTRANKS the photo-derived value and is marked grouping_source='curated' in the output.
_note: Facts about an animal are not copyrightable, so recording a trait from a reference source is fine — but cite it in _sources and link out rather than copying anyone's prose.
